title: Mental Health Therapist - Washington
description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists ( LMHC, LMFT, LICSW or Licensed Psychologists) in Washington State to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

• Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

• See credentialing information here.

• Full Time Providers:

•

• 40 hour work week

• Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week

• Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.

• Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation

• Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions

• Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding

• Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training

• Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).

•

• If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.

• Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

• Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.

•

• Masters Degree Required

• Washington: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker

• At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)

• Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required

• Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good

title: QA Inspektor
description:
Kvalita u nás není jen kolonka v tabulce. Je to jistota, že zákazník dostane přesně takové potraviny, jaké by si sám vybral v obchodě.

Do našeho týmu proto hledáme kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á bude přímo ve skladu hlídat kvalitu zboží - od chvíle, kdy k nám dorazí, během jeho skladování až po cestu k zákazníkovi.

Pokud máš dobré oko pro detail, jsi pečlivý/á a nebojíš se říct, když něco není v pořádku, tahle práce by Ti mohla sednout. Předchozí zkušenosti z kvality jsou výhodou, ale důležitější je pro nás spolehlivost, zodpovědnost a chuť dělat věci pořádně.

Co Tě u nás čeká

- Budeš kontrolovat kvalitu zboží při příjmu a hlídat, zda odpovídá našim standardům.

- Průběžně zkontroluješ produkty také během skladování a oddělíš zboží, které požadovanou kvalitu nesplňuje.

- Výsledky kontrol budeš jednoduše zaznamenávat, aby bylo vždy dohledatelné, co a kdy se kontrolovalo.

- Pokud narazíš na problém, předáš ho nadřízenému a pomůžeš s jeho řešením.

- Budeš se podílet na zavádění nápravných opatření, aby se stejné problémy zbytečně neopakovaly.

- Čeká Tě práce přímo v provozu skladu, včetně chladírenských prostor.

Hodíš se k nám, pokud:

- máš smysl pro detail a přesnost,

- je na tebe spoleh a umíš dodržovat nastavené postupy,

- dokážeš jasně komunikovat a upozornit na problém,

- nevadí Ti směnný provoz,

- zvládneš práci ve skladovém prostředí včetně chladnějších prostor,

- poradíš si s mobilem, aplikacemi a jednoduchým zadáváním dat,

- a umíš fungovat jako součást týmu.

Co je výhodou, ale ne podmínkou

- SŠ vzdělání v oblasti potravinářství, zemědělství nebo příbuzném oboru.

- Zkušenost ze skladu, maloobchodu, potravinářské výroby nebo kontroly kvality.

- Základní znalost angličtiny.

Co Ti nabízíme:

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupování s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - čas na pořádný odpočinek a regeneraci.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti každý den.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - 86 Kč navíc ke každé odpracované směně.

- Systém odměn za pochvaly - sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Multisport karta - příspěvek na sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - společné oslavy úspěchů a neformální večírky.

Proč právě tahle práce?

Výsledek svojí práce uvidíš každý den. Pomáháš rozhodovat o tom, jaké zboží se dostane až k zákazníkovi. Když něco není v pořádku, máš možnost to zachytit dřív, než produkt opustí sklad.

Hledáme někoho, komu záleží na tom, aby věci byly udělané správně - protože právě díky takovým lidem můžeme zákazníkům doručovat potraviny v kvalitě, kterou od Rohlíku očekávají.

title: Expert Animal Husbandry
description:
Expert Animal Husbandry
As an expert in the Animal Husbandry programme, you understand the crucial role livestock plays in food security, income generation, and the sustainable development of local communities. You bring proven experience with livestock production and animal feed systems, as well as technical knowledge of animal health and production. Are you ready to drive change within the Animal Husbandry programme worldwide and make a real impact? This is your opportunity!
About PUM
PUM is a unique NGO committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!
Who are you?

•
You have a track record of relevant experience in animal husbandry , for example:

• ruminant livestock in tropical climates;

• animal feed production , preferably with an expertise in animal nutrition and food processing technology;

• You are an authentic, resilient, humble and dynamic professional.

• You appreciate cultural differences and interact with equality and respect.

• You are eager to operate as a sparring partner in culturally diverse and changing circumstances.

• You are hands-on and can translate knowledge into a practical plan.

• You have excellent command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Bonus points for French or Spanish proficiency!

• You are comfortable with digital tools, including Microsoft Office 365.

• Discover more about the Animal Husbandry programme here.

Ready to make a difference?
As an expert at PUM , you play a key role. By sharing your knowledge and experience you’re empowering the sustainable growth of SMEs in countries worldwide. You’re not just an expert - you’re a change maker!
The role
Your application is for a place in our pool of experts for the animal husbandry programme, not for a specific project. Once you've joined, you will be matched with up to three projects per year, either on location or remotely. Around one in three projects will be delivered as remote advice, though working solely on remote advisory projects is also possible.
On location, you’ll spend two weeks on-site with the client. PUM covers your flight and visa, while the client takes care of your accommodation, meals, and local transportation. You will also receive an expense allowance.
As PUM expert you not only share knowledge, you also:

• Empower entrepreneurs, supporting their journey toward sustainable and inclusive business development.

• Leave a lasting impact on the community: socially, environmentally, and economically.

• Turn your knowledge into a hands-on project plan.

• Expand your horizons at sector days and building a network that’s as diverse as it gets.

Eligibility and Requirements
The expert role is a voluntary position. You can apply up to and including the calendar year in which you turn 69. PUM engages experts who reside in the Netherlands, are registered in the Municipal Personal Records Database (BRP), and have Dutch basic health insurance. Prescreening (VOG) is part of the selection process. At PUM , we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual to foster an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.
Join us!
By becoming a PUM expert, you’re not just stepping into a new role; you’re becoming a catalyst for positive change. It’s a two-way street of knowledge exchange that makes a global impact. Here’s what’s in it for you:
Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cu

description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment.  Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.

description:

The Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You’ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.

This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.

Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description:
WHO ARE WE?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ WHAT IS AT STAKE IN THE COMING MONTHS

- Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

- Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

- Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 YOUR MISSION

- Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

- Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

- Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

- Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

- Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

- Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

- Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

- Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

- First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

- 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

- 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 THIS JOB IS YOUR DREAM JOB IF:

- You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

- You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

- You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

- You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

- You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 THIS JOB IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

- You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

- You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

- You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Uri
description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Uri dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Lead Product Manager, Connectivity / Gateways
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Verkada's Connectivity products secure people and property in remote and edge environments. Our Cellular and Wi-Fi Gateways bring Verkada's full platform including threat detection, deterrence, and real-time visibility, anywhere it's needed. Verkada Gateways enable cameras, intercoms, access control, and sensors to be deployed in locations without stable internet or power.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and grow Verkada's Gateway product line. In this role, your mission is twofold: make gateways the enabling layer that unlocks every unwired Verkada deployment, and build the product depth and business model that grows Gateway into a flagship product.

What You'll Do

• Own strategy and execution for Verkada's Gateway product line

• Own and expand the gateway roadmap across reliability, fleet-scale cloud management, and new connectivity options and form factors.

• Partner with product lines across Verkada (remote cameras, security trailers, transportation, intercoms, access) to deliver connectivity-as-a-service and drive ecosystem attach

• Define data plan and pricing strategy that improves both customer adoption and Verkada margin

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B networking, connectivity, embedded systems, or IoT

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field. MS, PhD, or MBA optional

• Proven history of launching and scaling products and businesses. Strong customer intuition, technical depth, and ability to navigate tradeoffs are critical to success in this role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, WAN failover, SIM/carrier management), plus foundational knowledge of firmware, device bring-up, and hardware design

• Ability to build platform and recurring-revenue business models, with a structured approach to ambiguous problems like data plan pricing, carrier economics, attach-rate modeling, and ROI analysis

• Excited to roll up your sleeves and get out of the office. You'll spend time with installers, integrators, and customers deploying in unwired environments. You’ll use that insight to shape the product

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs. Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision, and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexib

Step into a  highly strategic Director-level role as the company’s NAND Industry Subject Matter Expert . You will be responsible for developing and maintaining a deep, forward-looking view of the NAND industry and using that expertise to help shape the company’s  five-year NAND strategy .

Working closely with our  Sourcing organization and Business Units , you will connect external NAND industry dynamics with our product, technology, supply, cost, and growth requirements. WHAT YOU BRING

• Expert-level knowledge of the NAND flash memory industry  with a deep understanding of the major suppliers, technologies, manufacturing economics, capacity, technology roadmaps, and competitive landscape.

• Strong understanding of NAND industry

But we have reached a point where the opportunity in front of us is larger than what organic relationship development alone can capture, and we are ready to invest in the commercial infrastructure to match.
This role exists to build and run that infrastructure. The Managing Director of Growth & Market Development is our first dedicated commercial leader, responsible for expanding the firm's pipeline, deepening our relationships with the private equity and investment banking communities, and making the practitioners around them more effective at winning work.
This is not a traditional sales role. The professionals you will be working alongside are credentialed, client-facing advisors who have built their reputations through exceptional delivery. Your job is to create the conditions in which more of their relationships convert to engagements, more opportunities move through the funnel with discipline, and the firm builds the kind of market visibility that generates inbound interest rather than just responding to it.
The mandate is both individual and organizational: you carry pipeline responsibility yourself, and you function as a force multiplier for every Director and Managing Director who is trying to grow a book of business alongside a full delivery load.

What You'll Do

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

We're looking for a field-based sales professional to join Teya's rapidly growing sales organisation. This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying new opportunities, and contributing to business growth within their territory.

Your responsibilities will include

- Consistently reach KPIs with little guidance and maintain accurate CRM records, reporting and pipeline visibility

- Proactively identify and engage prospective customers within your territory through outbound outreach, networking and referrals

- Meet customers face-to-face to understand their needs, challenges and goals, building trust through consultative conversations, value-led sales approaches and building long term relationships

- Expand Teya’s reach into new segments and win larger, high-value and multi-location clients using (not only) your past connections

- Develop strong knowledge across Teya's products and solutions, supported by internal and external training and train others and support junior sales agents through coaching, training and knowledge-sharing.

- Share and create insights on customer needs, competitors and market opportunities to improve Teya’s products, messaging, sales processes and merchant experience as well as identifying partnership potential and necessary integrations

- Get involved in cross-functional strategic projects, suggest improvements that impact area results and quality of deliveries

- Represent Teya as a credible, professional and values-led ambassador within your territory

- Build long-term customer relationships by identifying relevant upsell and cross-sell opportunities

- Contribute to a collaborative, high-performance sales culture that values learning and continuous improvement

Your Story

This role is about more than closing deals. It's an opportunity to build meaningful customer partnerships, develop your commercial capability further, and set the standard for a supportive, high-performing sales team.

You already understand what it takes to succeed in sales - prospecting, handling rejection, owning your number. You've built pipeline from scratch, closed against a target, and know what commercial judgement actually looks like in the field.

We're looking for people who can bring that experience in and raise the bar for everyone around them from day one. We want people who stay coachable, are open to adapting to our way of selling, and are motivated by more than a bigger base. If you've got the track record and the mindset to build on it here, you'll thrive.

We're looking for people who bring:

- A verifiable track record of quota attainment

- Strong prospecting discipline and pipeline management

- Sound commercial judgement and negotiation capability

title: Senior Data Science Engineer (Canada, EST, Remote)
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Data Science Engineer to provide applied data science expertise within our Success Engineering team, helping customers maximize the value of MindBridge’s control points and ensembles. You will configure and tune existing models, assess their application to customer data, investigate model behaviour and results, and translate complex findings into practical solutions. Working primarily post-launch, you will partner closely with Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to solve complex customer needs within MindBridge’s existing capabilities.
What You Will Do
Applied model & ensemble expertise
Maintain deep working knowledge of MindBridge's core detection methodologies: scoring logic, risk indicators, and how ensembles combine individual control points into a single output. Serve as the go-to technical resource within Success Engineering for questions about how a model or ensemble actually works.
Engineering & AI/ML liaison
Maintain an active, ongoing working relationship with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to stay current on model changes, known limitations, and upcoming capability shifts. Use that relationship to bring well-informed, technically grounded context back to Product/Engineering when a configurability gap is identified, a clear technical brief on what was requested, why it isn't currently supported, and what the customer's underlying value requirement needs, not just an administrative escalation.
Configurability boundaries & value mapping
Develop and maintain authoritative understanding of how, why, and to what extent MindBridge's core models and ensembles can be configured, which parameters are flexible, which are structurally fixed, and the statistical or product reasoning behind each boundary. Map a customer's stated business value requirement onto the specific configuration options actually available, and explain in plain terms what is, and is not, achievable within the current product.
Post-launch feasibility & configuration advisory
Evaluate customer requests to add, modify, or reconfigure a control point or ensemble, and determine whether it is feasible with existing product capability and the customer's available data. Define the specific data requirements: fields, quality, volume, structure - needed to support a proposed configuration. Recommend the configuration approach that best fits the customer's control objective within supported product capability.
Explainability & customer communication
Translate model and ensemble behavior into language finance, audit, and compliance stakeholders can act on: what it measures, how it scores, and why a specific result occurred. Support customers who need to justify or defend MindBridge's outputs to their own internal or external stakeholders, a recurring requirement in audit-facing use cases.
Root-cause diagnostics
When a control point or ensemble underperforms post-launch, determine whether the cause is data quality, configuration, or a genuine product limitation, and recommend the correct fix.
Escalation & product boundary stewardship
Distinguish clearly between a configuration question and a request that requires new product capability, and route the latter through Product/Engineering governance. Do not build bespoke workarounds to cover product gaps; document and escalate them instead.
Enablement & knowledge capture
Convert recurring model and configuration questions into FAQs, decision guides, and training material for Success Engineers, Success Engineering Architects, and Delivery Services.
Bounded support to Delivery Services
Act as an internal subject-matter-expert resource for Solutions Architects and Data Engineers specifically when an implementation calls for a control point or ensemble configuration that has not been built or validated before; not for routine, previously-validated feasibility questions, which remain owned by Delivery Services. We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.

Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

 

THE ROLE:

You'll be the infrastructure and reliability engineer on the Data Replication team - a full-stack product team running over 3 million sync jobs a week powering thousands of data use cases across multiple regions and clouds. You’ll build and maintain the infrastructure, set reliability standards, drive down incidents, and make it easier and safer for engineers to ship through tooling. You're equally comfortable in a Terraform file, a Kubernetes cluster, and a postmortem doc.

We expect engineers here to actively use AI as a force multiplier - agentic tools to automate toil, augment incident response, and build smarter internal tooling. - 7+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps.

- Ability & willingness to read backend code to understand how systems break and instrument them correctly.

- Fluency with AI tools - LLMs and agentic frameworks to automate, debug faster, and reduce toil.

- A startup-ready mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and owning problems end-to-end.

- Data pipelines, replication systems, or ETL/ELT platforms.

Most AI projects fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a spec, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements step is the bug. So we remove it.
As an Associate Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll join each engagement paired with a Senior FDE. Together you'll spend time alongside the client to understand their workflow and business needs. Then you'll help rebuild that work from first principles, and write real production code for it. You won't start from zero: every engagement begins from a Blueprint that has already shipped for a customer in that industry, and what you learn in the field goes back into it.
This role is for early-career engineers who want to learn how AI gets deployed in the real world - and who'd rather learn by building than by watching.

Consultor SAP Manufacturing (PP / QM / PM)
Descripción de la empresa
Cliente final de manufactura confidencial en Panama
Descripción de la vacante
El consultor SAP Manufacturing participará en la implementación y el despliegue (rollout) de Planificación de la Producción (PP), Gestión de la Calidad (QM) y Mantenimiento de Planta (PM) en
nuevas plantas, filiales o países, con base en una plantilla global. Trabajará con consultores senior, líderes funcionales y usuarios clave de producción, calidad y mantenimiento para asegurar una
configuración, validación y adopción correctas.
Responsabilidades Principales

• Participar en implantación y rollouts de SAP PP, QM y PM siguiendo la plantilla global
existente.

• Analizar los requerimientos de cada módulo e identificar brechas (fit-gap) frente a la plantilla

• PP: configurar datos maestros (BOM, hojas de ruta y recetas, puestos de trabajo, versiones de fabricación), MRP Live, MPS, órdenes de fabricación y de proceso, notificaciones y
entradas de producto terminado.

• QM: configurar características y planes de inspección, planes de muestreo, lotes de inspección, registro de resultados, decisión de empleo, notificaciones de calidad y certificados.

• PM: configurar ubicaciones técnicas, equipos, avisos y órdenes de mantenimiento, planes de mantenimiento preventivo, puntos de medida y gestión de repuestos.

• Asegurar la integración con MM, SD, CO (costos y liquidación de órdenes) y FI-AA.

• Participar en la migración y validación de datos maestros.

• Ejecutar pruebas unitarias (Unit Test), integrales (SIT) y de aceptación (UAT).

• Elaborar documentación funcional y materiales de capacitación, y capacitar a usuarios clave.

• Dar soporte en la salida a producción y la estabilización (hypercare), y resolver incidencias.

Requisitos

• Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, de Producción, Química, de Sistemas o
carreras afines.

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia en SAP.
Participación en al menos 3 proyectos completos de implementación o rollout SAP.

• Conocimientos funcionales sólidos de SAP PP y de al menos uno de los módulos QM o PM.

• Conocimiento de procesos de manufactura: planificación, producción, calidad y mantenimiento.

• Conocimientos de integración con MM y CO.

• Experiencia en pruebas funcionales, capacitación y soporte a usuarios

• Experiencia en entornos SAP S/4HANA.

• Inglés intermedio (B1-B2).

Deseable

• PP-DS (Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling): planificación detallada con capacidad finita, heurísticas, secuenciación y tablero de planificación en S/4HANA.

• AVC (Advanced Variant Configuration): modelado de productos configurables (clases, características, dependencias) y su efecto en BOM, hojas de ruta y planificación.

• DDMRP (Demand-Driven MRP): posicionamiento y dimensionamiento de buffers y planificación de reaprovisionamiento por demanda.

• También se valoran: experiencia en industrias reguladas (farmacéutica, alimentos, automotriz), mantenimiento predictivo, proyectos multi-país, la metodología SAP Activate y certificación SAP en Manufacturing.

• Make our research findable. Recommend search, filtering, and browsing patterns appropriate to a large and growing publications archive.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Location: Remote First; office location Moorgate, London (flexible remote working locations within UK/Europe)
Employment type: Permanent
Working Hours: Full-time (9-6 UK)
Salary: Up to £120,000 + Shares + Benefits

TransFICC is hiring a Network Infrastructure Engineer to provide high-performance, low-latency connectivity to our customers. We develop an integration service product that enables our clients to have a flexible, hosted service without requiring their internal resources to respond to connectivity challenges across trading venues.

You will be joining our SRE team and contributing to TransFICC’s culture of automation. We are a multi-disciplinary team covering everything from desktop and laptop support to data centre provisioning of servers and vendor network connectivity. 

We all have areas we are stronger in, but we all share responsibility for the entire environment. We are seeking someone like-minded who can contribute to our team while also learning from us. 

About the Role - Your mission will be:

- Research, design, deploy, and support new and existing networks, including network hardware vendors, routing/switching, low-latency technologies, telco circuits, and data centre connectivity.

- Network as Code: Develop new features, new automation and observability, and push to network new configurations and features to support our business. Ansible, Terraform.

- Support the network and the wider infrastructure.

- Interact with network vendors and circuit providers.

- Plan work in data centres.

What we are looking for:

- Need to know how to code. You don’t need to be an expert, but basic programming in your language of choice is required - you need to be able to build a program.

- Everything we configure at TransFICC is automated, so having experience with a software automation tool like Ansible and coding ability is a must.

- We are looking for someone experienced as a sys admin or network engineer; however, you must have a reasonable understanding of both.

- Constructive, open-minded and self-motivated. A belief in life learning, and an awareness of how much there still is to learn.

- Appreciate autonomy and be able to take the initiative.

- Experience managing 3rd parties via email and phone, negotiating with vendors, purchasing hardware and enabling remote work.

Ideally you would have some of the following:

- Experience in low-latency network technologies: TCP/IP, Multicast (IGMP, PIM), L2/L3, and WAN.

- Experience in deploying and supporting routing protocols such as BGP, EVPN.

- Experience with Arista or Cumulus Linux.

- Understanding of Firewall technologies, design, and vendors; and how to automate them.

- Coding experience with Python and Bash scripting to automate tasks.

- Knowledge of Ansible and Terraform to automate configuration deployment.

- Experience with Linux, both from an admin point of view and on the command line. 

- Experience in writing tests in Robot Framework.

- Well versed in observability and alerting stacks: Elastic, InfluxDB, Telegraf, Grafana

- Experience in troubleshooting system or network issues, tcpdump, wireshark, strace.

title: Junior Engineer
description:
Objective of the role
Raidiam ’s server-side team builds and runs the back-end services for Raidiam Connect, the ecosystem trust control system that digital identity ecosystems around the world rely on.

As a Junior Software Engineer you will work in the server-side team, primarily on our Java and Go services, as well as on infrastructure definition in terraform, and API definitions in OpenAPI, taking features and fixes from ticket to production with more experienced engineers around you to support you. The work is highly collaborative, the APIs we build are the contract other teams inside and outside of the company depend upon, so you will be in regular contact with product managers, UI developers and customer-facing colleagues, and with the people who operate the live environments. LLM-based coding assistants are a standard part of the team’s toolkit and will be part of yours.

Key responsibilities:

• Push new features and bug fixes into the Directory’s server-side codebases in Java and Go, taking each piece of work through refinement, implementation, automated testing and code review, and supporting release to production.

• Actively learn and adopt the technology and tools defined by the team, building genuine working fluency in both primary languages.

• Use LLM-based coding assistants as a routine part of how you work and take full responsibility for everything you submit: understand it, test it, and be able to explain and defend it in review.

• Write and maintain the automated tests, database migrations and API specification changes that go with your work, so that a change is finished when it is safely in production rather than when it compiles.

• Learn quickly from the engineers around you and consistently step up when it is required, and as you find your feet, proactively support other team members and help them to be successful.

• Contribute to code reviews as a junior engineer, to both help your learning process and because extra attention on our deliveries is always good.

• Help keep the products you contribute to healthy: investigate defects raised against them, help diagnose problems in deployed environments, and escalate clearly and early when an issue is beyond your scope.

• Take an active part in planning and estimation, and communicate progress, risks and blockers clearly.

Essential skills and qualifications

• Experience writing server-side code in at least one of Go or Java in a professional, academic, open-source or substantial personal-project setting, together with the demonstrated appetite and aptitude to become productive in the other.

• A working understanding of relational databases and SQL: able to read a schema, write basic queries and reason about a data model.

• Comfortable with HTTP and REST APIs

• Writes automated tests as a normal part of completing a piece of work, not as an afterthought.

• Everyday fluency with version control (Git), and familiarity with code review and continuous integration.

• Practical experience using LLM-based coding assistants, with the judgement to verify what they produce, the willingness to reject it when it is wrong, and the openness to be clear about what was generated.

• Able to take a well-defined piece of work and see it through to production, asking for direction when it is needed, and communicating clearly with the wider team while work is in progress

• A supportive and collaborative approach to working in a team: learns quickly from others, asks for help early, offers it readily, and both gives and receives code review well.

• Clear written and spoken English, much of our work is documented, reviewed asynchronously and shared with external ecosystem participants and regulators. As we are a globally distributed company with fully remote working practices, communication is key.

Desirable

• Exposure to AWS or similar cloud service.

• Experience with Micronaut, Spring Boot or a comparable JVM framework.

• Experience with infrastructure as code
